variants.seoContent:
Dyson Airblade™ V (Nickel) Hand Dryer HU02 – The Future of Commercial Hygiene

The Dyson Airblade V (Nickel) HU02 is a high-performance, wall-mounted commercial hand drying solution engineered for high-traffic environments where speed, durability, and energy efficiency are non-negotiable. Powered by the Dyson digital motor V4, one of the world's smallest fully integrated 1000W motors, it delivers a high-velocity sheet of air that scrapes water from hands in seconds.

Designed with a slim, modern profile, the Airblade V protrudes only 10 centimeters from the wall, making it an ideal choice for compact washrooms in offices, hospitals, airports, and restaurants across Pakistan. Its premium Nickel finish provides a professional aesthetic that complements high-end interior designs.

Unmatched Hygiene with HEPA Filtration

In hygiene-critical environments, the quality of air matters. Unlike conventional dryers that circulate contaminated washroom air, the Airblade V is equipped with a sealed HEPA filter. This advanced filtration system captures 99.95% of particles, including bacteria and viruses, ensuring that hands are dried with clean air every single time.

Sustainable and Cost-Effective

Switching to the Dyson Airblade V helps organizations reduce their carbon footprint by eliminating the waste and logistics associated with paper towels. By utilizing unheated, high-pressure airflow, it consumes significantly less energy than traditional warm-air dryers, leading to substantial long-term savings on operational costs and electricity bills.

  • 220–240V Compatible for Pakistan: Fully optimized for local electrical standards, ensuring safe and reliable performance in commercial buildings.
  • HEPA-Filtered Clean Air: Captures 99.95% of particles and bacteria, providing the most hygienic hand-drying experience available.
  • 12-Second Dry Time: The powerful digital motor V4 creates "blades" of air that dry hands rapidly, improving washroom flow during peak hours.
  • Slim Space-Saving Design: Protrudes just 10cm from the wall, maximizing available space without sacrificing power or durability.
  • NSF and Quiet Mark Certified: Acoustically engineered to reduce noise while maintaining strict sanitary standards for food-service and healthcare sectors.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Dyson Airblade V (Nickel) Hand Dryer HU02

Which voltage is compatible in Pakistan?

The Dyson Airblade V HU02 is designed for 220–240V, fully compatible with Pakistan’s electrical systems for safe operation.

What is the drying time for hands?

It dries hands in approximately 10–14 seconds using Dyson’s high-velocity airflow technology, ensuring quick and hygienic drying.

Is it hygienic and safe for public spaces?

Yes, the Airblade V uses HEPA filtration to capture 99.95% of bacteria and viruses from the air used to dry hands.

What is the warranty period?

The Dyson Airblade V HU02 comes with a 2-year international warranty, ensuring full coverage and peace of mind.

Is it easy to install in washrooms?

Yes, the slim and compact design allows flexible installation in washrooms, with wall-mounted options for both small and large spaces.

Does it have energy-saving features?

Yes, the Dyson Airblade V consumes less energy than traditional hand dryers, reducing operating costs while maintaining performance.
